venue.name: Pacific Northwest Expeditions
venue.description: Pacific Northwest Expeditions was a Nanaimo based sea kayaking outfitter running multi day guided trips to Johnstone Strait, Clayoquot Sound, the Broken Group Islands and the Gulf Islands. Its website no longer exists. Both seakayakbc.com and www.seakayakbc.com fail to resolve in a browser, and no other official site for the company could be found. Nothing about its trips, prices, age limits or whether it is still operating can be confirmed.

gaps: RETRIEVAL NOTE: the website is gone. Both seakayakbc.com and www.seakayakbc.com return a DNS failure in a live browser, meaning the domain no longer resolves. A plain fetch of the same address still returns a healthy looking copy of the old home page from a cache, so a fetch only re-run will appear to find a working site. It is not working. Do not extract from that cached copy.
The cached copy describes the company as being in its sixteenth year, which puts the text many years out of date on top of the domain being dead.
A single web search turned up nothing but third party tourism listings and directories. There is no replacement official website to follow, so the row needs a new address or needs retiring.

Minimum age: unknown, and this is the one thing worth chasing. Similar sea kayaking operators publish an age floor that rules daycare groups out, but with the site down there is nothing to read, so nobody should assume either way.
Price, trip length, group size, what happens in bad weather and whether they take school or daycare groups at all: none of it can be checked while the site is down.
No address published, so there is nothing to geocode. The old cached page gave only a post office box in Nanaimo, which is not a place a group could go.
